execution: Unexecuted failure-injection cases; source review only. No host, service, bus, policy or desktop access is authorized.

cases.name: forward-dispatch-alias
cases.inject: Alias reads a COMMANDS key first declared in the same update mapping.
cases.expected: Installation verification rejects it before menu activation; no dispatcher execution is used for the check.

cases.name: output-startup-dock-dependency
cases.inject: Dock is activating while ordered After the notifying output watcher.
cases.expected: Initial reconciliation defers the modeset, sends readiness after subscribing, and never joins the pending dock start job.

cases.name: output-connector-replaced
cases.inject: Topology changes after dock shutdown and before submitting the prepared plan.
cases.expected: No stale transaction is submitted; dock/authority cleanup retains the existing ownership lock.

cases.name: output-commit-rejected
cases.inject: A transaction returns Device or resource busy or times out after submission.
cases.expected: Return failure, issue no replay using the same argv, retain paired transaction diagnostics and require a new snapshot for later reconciliation.

cases.name: system-controls-click-drawer
cases.inject: Click the system leader, then click the settings child while the quick-controls drawer is open.
cases.expected: The drawer opens and closes only from the system leader click; the settings child owns the left-click GTK menu; no right-click handler or independent hover reveal remains.

cases.name: transient-concurrent-actions
cases.expected: Distinct readable unit names retain each cgroup until its descendants exit; no shared deterministic unit silently replaces another action.

cases.name: session-closing-action
cases.inject: Session closing marker appears before a queued transient action starts.
cases.expected: Service condition rejects execution; no host helper or native application starts.

cases.name: credential-prompt-cancel-or-deadline
cases.inject: User cancels KWallet creation/unlock, or the bounded first-publication window expires.
cases.expected: No automatic prompt restart; private bootstrap remains; no credentials-ready receipt is published before successful readback; explicit retry is available.

cases.name: credential-input-replaced
cases.inject: Bootstrap inode or recorded metadata changes during Secret Service publication.
cases.expected: Do not unlink replacement input or publish readiness; retain recovery input and report failure.

cases.name: preset-partial-preview
cases.inject: One native field cannot be extracted from the rendered preset.
cases.expected: No partial draft update, publication, refresh or authentication; preserve other component drafts.

cases.name: preset-save-failure
cases.inject: Existing transactional publication fails or its final readback cannot be completed.
cases.expected: Retain drafts and existing recovery journal; distinguish incomplete update from saved-but-unreadable state; do not retry an uncertain mutation.

cases.name: apps-open-pointer-leaves
cases.inject: Open the native Apps click drawer, then move the pointer away from its leader and the group.
cases.expected: The group PRELIGHT state remains set and the Apps leader retains its bright icon, background, outline and shadow in both output layouts.

cases.name: apps-close-pointer-remains
cases.inject: Click the Apps leader again while its drawer is open; keep the pointer over the button.
cases.expected: The group PRELIGHT state clears and every Apps leader color returns to normal immediately; no independent leader-hover color keeps it bright.

cases.name: apps-leader-event-conflict
cases.inject: Add a native GTK menu or click handler to the Apps leader.
cases.expected: Installation verification rejects the event conflict before activation, preserving native drawer ownership.

cases.name: fuzzel-dismisses-waybar-menu
cases.inject: Open a Waybar GTK menu, then invoke a managed Fuzzel launcher from that menu or a hotkey.
cases.expected: The launcher requests the Waybar service ExecReload before spawning Fuzzel, waits only for a bounded menu teardown turn without replacing the bar process, and still launches when Waybar is stopped or the request fails.

cases.name: greeter-output-idempotent-modeset
cases.inject: Labwc has already auto-enabled the selected greeter connector before the greeter output controller runs.
cases.expected: The controller compares the live connector state and skips a redundant atomic modeset when Enabled, Position, Scale, and the requested current mode already match.

cases.name: greeter-output-single-atomic-transaction
cases.inject: The greeter has one selected connector and one already-enabled non-selected connector while a page flip is pending.
cases.expected: The controller sends one complete output transaction, omits already-disabled connectors, and does not replay per-output commits that can queue behind the pending i915 page flip; a busy or timed-out preferred-mode commit is not immediately retried with a fallback mode.

cases.name: apparmor-pathname-unix-address
cases.inject: Add a unix peer addr condition containing /run/user/[0-9]*/systemd/notify.
cases.expected: The changed-file checker rejects the parser-invalid filesystem address; the pathname remains covered by an ordinary file rule.
